text:
Priya Patel: Quick status on Optimize toolkit delivery — quant recommendations are ready for review. We're leaning toward 4-bit perf profile (q4_neo) for most traffic. Need owners for rollout, canary window, and regression monitoring. cc @Kevin Zhao @Matt Green :raised_hands:

Kevin Zhao: saw the PRs briefly. Where are the model artifacts & perf numbers? link?

Priya Patel: artifacts + perf table in repo: https://stash.redwood/optkit/quant-recs (private). Perf summary: 2.3x token/s improvement, 18% p99 latency delta vs baseline. Table in /reports/q4-summary.md

Daria Ivanova: FYI our nightly bench found regression on decoding for long context (test: decode_long_context_regression). Fails at ~1.2k tokens. Stack:
```
AssertionError: p99 > baseline_p99 * 1.15
at bench.decode.test_long_context
```

Matt Green: I can own the staging canary if Kevin owns the rollout plan. What's the expected canary size? 5%? 1%?

Kevin Zhao: plan: start 1% for 12h, if no perf regressions bump to 5% for 24h, then full. I'll draft the rollout doc today. Owning rollout.

Chris Lee: are we changing KV cache semantics? any compatibility PRs that infra needs to merge? PRs: #2345 (cache key bump), #2351 (kv-ttl change)

Priya Patel: yes small cache key change to include quant metadata, runtime needs to accept 'quant_profile' in route config. Daria — monitoring gets alerted on decode_long_context_regression. Matt — canary window 6/12 18:00 UTC (tentative).

infra-team: infra note — need CUDA 12 image with cuDNN 9 for q4 kernel. ETA to publish image: 48h.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 1759016000 (2025-06-12T18:00:00Z) by Kevin Zhao. :tada:

Priya Patel: Action items: Kevin write rollout doc + steps, Matt schedule canary + smoke tests, Daria add regression gates in monitoring, Chris confirm PR merges with infra, infra-team push image. Ping here when docs/PRs ready.

Kevin Zhao: will post rollout doc by EOD and link PRs.

Daria Ivanova: adding alert rule now — will comment with link.

Matt Green: I'll stub smoke test checklist in the canary runbook.

Priya Patel: thanks all — checking back in 24h. :coffee:
